732.summary: The class explores the historical context and controversies surrounding the doctrine of atonement within the Christadelphian community, focusing on the implications of inherited sin and the nature of man's accountability before God.

733.summary: The class discusses the concept of inherited sin from Adam, focusing on Romans 5:12 and the implications of the aorist tense in the Greek text. It also examines the legalistic theories of J.J. Andrews and the historical controversies within the Christadelphian community regarding resurrection and atonement.

734.summary: The class discusses the historical context of the atonement in the Christadelphian community, focusing on the debates and divisions related to J.J. Andrews' teachings and the amendment to the Statement of Faith. It emphasizes the significance of Jesus Christ's crucifixion in the context of salvation and justification.
